create_page_assemble_model: create a PageAssembleModel instance that assembles page elements from layout clusters into a structured document
sanitize_text_lines: sanitize text lines by removing hyphenation breaks, normalizing quotes, and expanding Unicode ligatures to ASCII equivalents
match_hyperlink_bbox: match a hyperlink URI to a layout cluster bounding box based on spatial overlap coverage threshold
build_page_assembled_unit: build an AssembledUnit from layout clusters containing text, tables, figures, and container elements
run_page_assemble_pipeline: run the page assemble pipeline on a conversion result to produce structured page output with headers and body elements
